first.rationale: A segmented onboarding-simplification experiment best addresses both declining completion and activation while avoiding the retention damage associated with promotional pricing. Limit eligibility to self-serve, non-complex workspaces and retain the full flow for complex accounts. Verify the onboarding result and compare it with activation messaging before committing, with sustainable qualified revenue and downstream retention as decision metrics.

final.rationale: Run a segmented onboarding-simplification experiment only for self-serve simple-workspace accounts, while preserving the full flow for complex workspaces. This directly targets the 4% completion decline and may improve activation and time-to-value. Exclude complex accounts because verified evidence shows 60-day churn increased 9% there. Measure qualified activation, retention, and revenue—not completion alone. Activation messaging is the safer fallback, but onboarding simplification addresses both current funnel declines.
